cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Senior Business Analyst position at Example Enterprise Solutions. My background spans business analysis roles in fictional cloud software, financial services, and telecommunications environments. I am particularly interested in a role that combines requirements engineering, process improvement, data analysis, and cross-functional delivery.

At Northstar Cloud Systems, I documented functional and non-functional requirements for a cloud operations platform. I modeled current and future processes using BPMN, prepared user stories and use cases, and supported two Scrum teams. I also analyzed REST API and web-service integration scenarios, including field mappings and error handling. These experiences are relevant to your focus on integration design and clear communication with development teams.

My work also included SQL-based data validation, system integration testing, and coordination of user acceptance testing. Earlier roles involved functional specifications, process diagrams, and stakeholder workshops. I have also evaluated potential AI-assisted workflow improvements, while recognizing that practical applications require human review and appropriate controls.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how this experience could support your business analysis and product improvement priorities. Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Alex Morgan
